suggestion.description: FBS-112: six hours of lighting checks for Harbour Expo

ledger.description: Payment for supplier bill FBS-184, Studio Library cataloguing.
Booked clearing payment for the April contribution batch.

evidence.title: Supplier walk-through
evidence.body: 09:00–10:00. Juniper Works team visited the Foundry Rooms to discuss catering. No purchases are recorded in this invitation.

evidence.title: Studio supply collection
evidence.body: 14:30–15:00. A second team member planned a stationery pick-up. The calendar entry contains no supplier, amount or receipt.

evidence.title: Card descriptor enquiry
evidence.body: Finance asked who used Tidegate Pay on 8 May. Tidegate processes payments for several shops. The merchant receipt has not been found.

evidence.title: Dockside Design Forum
evidence.body: 09:00–16:00 at South Quay Hall. Lunch for 30 attendees at 12:15. The delivery coordinator will drive the signage and catering supplies to the hall.

evidence.title: Lunch order MSK-217
evidence.body: Mallow Street Kitchen sent a paid receipt for 30 lunch packs delivered to South Quay Hall. Total AUD 693.00 including AUD 63.00 GST.

evidence.title: Dockside lunch delivery
evidence.body: In the Dockside Design Forum channel, the host wrote: “All 30 Mallow Street lunch packs are at registration for the forum. Order MSK-217 is complete.”

evidence.title: MSK-217 · Mallow Street Kitchen
evidence.body: Paid receipt for the 30 Dockside Design Forum lunch packs.

evidence.title: Parking receipt SQP-834
evidence.body: South Quay Parking sent the receipt for bay 58, AUD 42.90 including AUD 3.90 GST.

evidence.title: Parking at South Quay Hall
evidence.body: The forum coordinator posted: “I unloaded the signs at South Quay Hall and parked in bay 58 for the forum. Parking was on the business card.”

evidence.title: SQP-834 · South Quay Parking
evidence.body: Exit receipt for bay 58 showing the parking date and amount.

evidence.title: Invoice FBS-184 for Studio Library
evidence.body: Finch Bench Studio invoiced 12 cataloguing hours for Studio Library. The invoice references FBS-184, AUD 1,188.00 including AUD 108.00 GST.

evidence.title: Studio Library invoice paid
evidence.body: Finance posted: “FBS-184 is approved, and its $1,188 payment is in the books. FBS-112 was the old lighting job.”

evidence.title: FBS-184 · Finch Bench Studio invoice
evidence.body: Supplier invoice for 12 hours of Studio Library cataloguing.

evidence.title: May team licences · OIC-519
evidence.body: Orbit Ink Cloud sent Juniper Works a paid receipt for five workspace licences for May. Total AUD 187.00 including AUD 17.00 GST.

evidence.title: Shared workspace renewals
evidence.body: Operations confirmed that Orbit Ink Cloud is the shared team workspace. Its licences are tracked to Juniper operations.

evidence.title: OIC-519 · Orbit Ink Cloud
evidence.body: Paid receipt for the five May workspace licences.

evidence.title: Silverbank batch SB-4509 settled
evidence.body: Silverbank Benefits confirmed settlement of the April contribution batch on 15 May. Batch SB-4509 total AUD 627.35.

evidence.title: Contribution batch in ledger
evidence.body: Payroll entered the clearing payment for SB-4509. The April contributions were expensed in the payroll run.
